datasets.name: current_health
queryLines: SELECT monitor_id, model_catalog, model_schema, model_name, model_version, selection, health_status, measurement_status, observed_at, measured_at, current_rows, scored_rows, labeled_rows, label_coverage, drifted_columns, error_message, CASE WHEN health_status = 'healthy' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS healthy_count, CASE WHEN health_status = 'drift' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS drift_count, CASE WHEN health_status = 'degraded' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS degraded_count, CASE WHEN health_status = 'stale' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS stale_count, CASE WHEN health_status = 'failed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS failed_count, CASE WHEN health_status = 'no_data' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS no_data_count, CASE WHEN health_status = 'disabled' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS disabled_count, CASE WHEN health_status = 'never_observed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS never_observed_count, CASE WHEN health_status = 'unavailable' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS unavailable_count FROM current_health ORDER BY model_name, model_version, monitor_id

datasets.name: metric_history
queryLines:
WITH wide AS (
SELECT monitor_id, report_id, model_catalog, model_schema, model_name, model_version, measured_at, observed_at, column_name, measurement_status,
MAX(CASE WHEN metric_name = 'psi' THEN value END) AS psi,
MAX(CASE WHEN metric_name = 'ks_statistic' THEN value END) AS ks_statistic,
MAX(CASE WHEN metric_name = 'ks_test_p_value' THEN value END) AS ks_test_p_value,
MAX(CASE WHEN metric_name = 'wasserstein_distance' THEN value END) AS wasserstein_distance,
MAX(CASE WHEN metric_name = 'kl_divergence' THEN value END) AS kl_divergence,
MAX(CASE WHEN metric_name = 'schema_missing' THEN value END) AS schema_missing,
MAX(CASE WHEN metric_name = 'missing_fraction' THEN value END) AS missing_fraction,
MAX(CASE WHEN metric_name = 'nonfinite_fraction' THEN value END) AS nonfinite_fraction,
concat_ws(', ', sort_array(collect_set(CASE WHEN status = 'unavailable' THEN metric_name END))) AS unavailable_metrics,
concat_ws(', ', sort_array(collect_set(CASE WHEN has_issue THEN metric_name END))) AS flagged_metrics
,
MAX(CASE WHEN metric_name = 'psi' THEN threshold END) AS psi_threshold,
MAX(CASE WHEN metric_name = 'ks_statistic' THEN threshold END) AS ks_statistic_threshold,
MAX(CASE WHEN metric_name = 'wasserstein_distance' THEN threshold END) AS wasserstein_distance_threshold,
MAX(CASE WHEN metric_name = 'kl_divergence' THEN threshold END) AS kl_divergence_threshold,
MAX(CASE WHEN metric_name IN ('schema_missing', 'type_drift') THEN value END) AS schema_change,
concat_ws(', ', sort_array(collect_set(CASE WHEN has_issue AND metric_name <> 'ks_test_p_value' THEN metric_name END))) AS drift_issues
FROM metric_history WHERE category = 'drift'
GROUP BY monitor_id, report_id, model_catalog, model_schema, model_name, model_version, measured_at, observed_at, column_name, measurement_status
) SELECT *, CASE WHEN psi IS NULL THEN 'Unavailable' ELSE concat(cast(round(psi, 4) AS STRING), ' / ', cast(psi_threshold AS STRING)) END AS psi_display,
CASE WHEN ks_statistic IS NULL THEN 'Unavailable' ELSE concat(cast(round(ks_statistic, 4) AS STRING), ' / ', cast(ks_statistic_threshold AS STRING)) END AS ks_statistic_display,
CASE WHEN wasserstein_distance IS NULL THEN 'Unavailable' ELSE concat(cast(round(wasserstein_distance, 4) AS STRING), ' / ', cast(wasserstein_distance_threshold AS STRING)) END AS wasserstein_distance_display,
CASE WHEN kl_divergence IS NULL THEN 'Unavailable' ELSE concat(cast(round(kl_divergence, 4) AS STRING), ' / ', cast(kl_divergence_threshold AS STRING)) END AS kl_divergence_display,
CASE WHEN drift_issues <> '' THEN 'Drift detected' WHEN unavailable_metrics <> '' THEN 'Some checks unavailable' ELSE 'No drift detected' END AS drift_status FROM wide ORDER BY measured_at DESC, model_name, column_name, report_id

datasets.name: quality_history
queryLines:
WITH wide AS (
SELECT monitor_id, report_id, model_catalog, model_schema, model_name, model_version, measured_at, observed_at, column_name, measurement_status,
MAX(CASE WHEN metric_name = 'psi' THEN value END) AS psi,
MAX(CASE WHEN metric_name = 'ks_statistic' THEN value END) AS ks_statistic,
MAX(CASE WHEN metric_name = 'ks_test_p_value' THEN value END) AS ks_test_p_value,
MAX(CASE WHEN metric_name = 'wasserstein_distance' THEN value END) AS wasserstein_distance,
MAX(CASE WHEN metric_name = 'kl_divergence' THEN value END) AS kl_divergence,
MAX(CASE WHEN metric_name = 'schema_missing' THEN value END) AS schema_missing,
MAX(CASE WHEN metric_name = 'missing_fraction' THEN value END) AS missing_fraction,
MAX(CASE WHEN metric_name = 'nonfinite_fraction' THEN value END) AS nonfinite_fraction,
concat_ws(', ', sort_array(collect_set(CASE WHEN status = 'unavailable' THEN metric_name END))) AS unavailable_metrics,
concat_ws(', ', sort_array(collect_set(CASE WHEN has_issue THEN metric_name END))) AS flagged_metrics
FROM metric_history WHERE category = 'quality'
GROUP BY monitor_id, report_id, model_catalog, model_schema, model_name, model_version, measured_at, observed_at, column_name, measurement_status
) SELECT *, CASE WHEN flagged_metrics <> '' THEN 'Data quality issue' WHEN unavailable_metrics <> '' THEN 'Unavailable' ELSE 'No issues' END AS quality_status FROM wide ORDER BY observed_at DESC, model_name, column_name, report_id

datasets.name: performance_measurements
datasets.displayName: Measured performance by target and report
queryLines:
WITH wide AS (
SELECT monitor_id, report_id, model_catalog, model_schema, model_name, model_version, measured_at, observed_at, column_name, measurement_status,
MAX(CASE WHEN metric_name = 'rmse' THEN value END) AS rmse,
MAX(CASE WHEN metric_name = 'mae' THEN value END) AS mae,
MAX(CASE WHEN metric_name = 'mse' THEN value END) AS mse,
MAX(CASE WHEN metric_name = 'r2' THEN value END) AS r2,
MAX(CASE WHEN metric_name = 'mape' THEN value END) AS mape,
MAX(CASE WHEN metric_name = 'explained_variance' THEN value END) AS explained_variance,
MAX(CASE WHEN metric_name = 'accuracy' THEN value END) AS accuracy,
MAX(CASE WHEN metric_name = 'balanced_accuracy' THEN value END) AS balanced_accuracy,
MAX(CASE WHEN metric_name = 'precision' THEN value END) AS precision,
MAX(CASE WHEN metric_name = 'recall' THEN value END) AS recall,
MAX(CASE WHEN metric_name = 'f1' THEN value END) AS f1,
MAX(CASE WHEN metric_name = 'precision_weighted' THEN value END) AS precision_weighted,
MAX(CASE WHEN metric_name = 'recall_weighted' THEN value END) AS recall_weighted,
MAX(CASE WHEN metric_name = 'f1_weighted' THEN value END) AS f1_weighted,
MAX(CASE WHEN metric_name = 'g_score' THEN value END) AS g_score,
MAX(CASE WHEN metric_name = 'matthews_corrcoef' THEN value END) AS matthews_corrcoef,
MAX(CASE WHEN metric_name = 'roc_auc' THEN value END) AS roc_auc,
MAX(CASE WHEN metric_name = 'pr_auc' THEN value END) AS pr_auc,
MAX(CASE WHEN metric_name = 'log_loss' THEN value END) AS log_loss,
MAX(CASE WHEN metric_name = 'roc_auc_ovr' THEN value END) AS roc_auc_ovr,
MAX(CASE WHEN metric_name = 'roc_auc_ovo' THEN value END) AS roc_auc_ovo,
MAX(CASE WHEN metric_name = 'roc_auc_ovr_weighted' THEN value END) AS roc_auc_ovr_weighted,
MAX(CASE WHEN metric_name = 'roc_auc_ovo_weighted' THEN value END) AS roc_auc_ovo_weighted,
MAX(CASE WHEN metric_name = 'roc_auc_weighted' THEN value END) AS roc_auc_weighted,
MAX(CASE WHEN metric_name = 'pr_auc_weighted' THEN value END) AS pr_auc_weighted,
concat_ws(', ', sort_array(collect_set(CASE WHEN status = 'unavailable' THEN metric_name END))) AS unavailable_metrics,
concat_ws(', ', sort_array(collect_set(CASE WHEN has_issue THEN metric_name END))) AS flagged_metrics
FROM metric_history WHERE category = 'performance'
GROUP BY monitor_id, report_id, model_catalog, model_schema, model_name, model_version, measured_at, observed_at, column_name, measurement_status
) SELECT w.*, r.scored_rows, r.labeled_rows, CASE WHEN r.status = 'failed' THEN 'Measurement failed'
 WHEN r.scored_rows IS NULL OR r.scored_rows = 0 THEN 'No predictions to evaluate'
 WHEN r.labeled_rows = 0 THEN concat(cast(r.scored_rows AS STRING), ' predictions; waiting for actual target values')
 WHEN r.labeled_rows < 2 THEN concat(cast(r.scored_rows AS STRING), ' predictions; only 1 actual target matched; at least 2 are required for performance')
 ELSE concat(cast(r.scored_rows AS STRING), ' predictions; ', cast(r.labeled_rows AS STRING), ' matched actual targets; performance calculated from these ', cast(r.labeled_rows AS STRING), ' records') END AS outcome_summary FROM wide w JOIN monitoring_results r ON w.report_id = r.report_id ORDER BY w.measured_at DESC, w.model_name, w.report_id

datasets.name: performance_cells
queryLines:
WITH observations AS (
 SELECT DISTINCT report_id, monitor_id, model_name, model_version, column_name, measured_at
 FROM metric_history WHERE category = 'performance'
), numbered AS (
 SELECT *, count(*) OVER (PARTITION BY model_name, model_version, column_name, measured_at) AS same_time,
 row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY model_name, model_version, column_name, measured_at ORDER BY monitor_id, report_id) AS sequence
 FROM observations
)
SELECT m.report_id, m.monitor_id, m.model_catalog, m.model_schema, m.model_name, m.model_version,
 m.column_name, m.measured_at, m.observed_at, m.metric_name, m.value,
 concat(date_format(m.measured_at, 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss.SSSSSS'),
   CASE WHEN n.same_time > 1 THEN concat(' #', cast(n.sequence AS STRING)) ELSE '' END) AS observation,
 CASE WHEN r.status = 'failed' THEN 'Measurement failed'
 WHEN r.scored_rows IS NULL OR r.scored_rows = 0 THEN 'No predictions to evaluate'
 WHEN r.labeled_rows = 0 THEN concat(cast(r.scored_rows AS STRING), ' predictions; waiting for actual target values')
 WHEN r.labeled_rows < 2 THEN concat(cast(r.scored_rows AS STRING), ' predictions; only 1 actual target matched; at least 2 are required for performance')
 ELSE concat(cast(r.scored_rows AS STRING), ' predictions; ', cast(r.labeled_rows AS STRING), ' matched actual targets; performance calculated from these ', cast(r.labeled_rows AS STRING), ' records') END AS outcome_summary
FROM metric_history m JOIN numbered n ON m.report_id = n.report_id AND m.column_name = n.column_name
JOIN monitoring_results r ON m.report_id = r.report_id
WHERE m.category = 'performance'
ORDER BY m.measured_at DESC, m.model_name, m.metric_name

datasets.name: performance_chart
queryLines:
WITH selected AS (
 SELECT * FROM metric_history WHERE category = 'performance'
 AND metric_name = :performance_metric AND model_name = :trend_model AND model_version = :trend_version
), identity_count AS (SELECT count(DISTINCT monitor_id) AS monitors FROM selected)
SELECT report_id, monitor_id, model_catalog, model_schema, model_name, model_version,
 measured_at, observed_at, column_name, metric_name, value,
 concat(upper(metric_name), CASE WHEN metric_name IN ('mae','mse','rmse','mape','log_loss')
   THEN ' — lower is better' ELSE ' — higher is better' END, ' / ', column_name) AS metric_label
FROM selected WHERE (SELECT monitors FROM identity_count) = 1
ORDER BY measured_at, report_id

datasets.name: performance_choices
queryLines: SELECT DISTINCT metric_name FROM metric_history WHERE category = 'performance' ORDER BY metric_name

datasets.name: drift_psi_chart
queryLines:
WITH selected AS (
 SELECT * FROM metric_history WHERE category = 'drift'
 AND model_name = :drift_model AND model_version = :drift_version
), identity_count AS (SELECT count(DISTINCT monitor_id) AS monitors FROM selected)
, ranked AS (
 SELECT *, dense_rank() OVER (ORDER BY measured_at DESC, report_id DESC) AS report_rank
 FROM selected WHERE (SELECT monitors FROM identity_count) = 1
), top_features AS (
 SELECT * FROM ranked WHERE report_rank = 1 AND metric_name = 'psi'
 ORDER BY value DESC NULLS LAST, column_name LIMIT 10
)
SELECT report_id, monitor_id, model_catalog, model_schema, model_name, model_version,
 measured_at, observed_at, measurement_status, column_name, value AS plot_value,
 'Measured PSI' AS series FROM top_features
UNION ALL
SELECT report_id, monitor_id, model_catalog, model_schema, model_name, model_version,
 measured_at, observed_at, measurement_status, column_name, threshold AS plot_value,
 'PSI limit' AS series FROM top_features
ORDER BY column_name, series

datasets.name: drift_trend
queryLines:
WITH selected AS (
 SELECT * FROM metric_history WHERE category = 'drift'
 AND model_name = :drift_model AND model_version = :drift_version
), identity_count AS (SELECT count(DISTINCT monitor_id) AS monitors FROM selected)
, features AS (
 SELECT report_id, monitor_id, model_catalog, model_schema, model_name, model_version,
 measured_at, observed_at, measurement_status, column_name,
 MAX(CASE WHEN has_issue THEN 1 WHEN status = 'measured' THEN 0 END) AS drifted_feature,
 MAX(CASE WHEN status = 'unavailable' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS unavailable_feature
 FROM selected WHERE (SELECT monitors FROM identity_count) = 1
 AND metric_name <> 'ks_test_p_value'
 GROUP BY report_id, monitor_id, model_catalog, model_schema, model_name, model_version,
 measured_at, observed_at, measurement_status, column_name
)
SELECT report_id, monitor_id, model_catalog, model_schema, model_name, model_version,
 measured_at, observed_at, measurement_status, column_name,
 concat(date_format(measured_at, 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss'), ' ', current_timezone()) AS measurement_time,
 drifted_feature AS feature_count,
 'Drift detected' AS series FROM features
UNION ALL
SELECT report_id, monitor_id, model_catalog, model_schema, model_name, model_version,
 measured_at, observed_at, measurement_status, column_name,
 concat(date_format(measured_at, 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss'), ' ', current_timezone()) AS measurement_time,
 unavailable_feature AS feature_count,
 'Checks unavailable' AS series FROM features
ORDER BY measured_at, report_id, series, column_name

datasets.name: performance_latest
queryLines:
WITH history AS (
WITH selected AS (
 SELECT * FROM metric_history WHERE category = 'performance'
 AND metric_name = :performance_metric AND model_name = :trend_model AND model_version = :trend_version
), identity_count AS (SELECT count(DISTINCT monitor_id) AS monitors FROM selected)
SELECT report_id, monitor_id, model_catalog, model_schema, model_name, model_version,
 measured_at, observed_at, column_name, metric_name, value,
 concat(upper(metric_name), CASE WHEN metric_name IN ('mae','mse','rmse','mape','log_loss')
   THEN ' — lower is better' ELSE ' — higher is better' END, ' / ', column_name) AS metric_label
FROM selected WHERE (SELECT monitors FROM identity_count) = 1
ORDER BY measured_at, report_id
), ranked AS (
 SELECT *, dense_rank() OVER (ORDER BY measured_at DESC, report_id DESC) AS report_rank
 FROM history
)
SELECT * FROM ranked WHERE report_rank = 1 ORDER BY column_name

datasets.name: performance_policy
queryLines: SELECT report_id, monitor_id, environment, project, model_name, model_version, model_catalog, model_schema, measured_at, observed_at, window_start, window_end, status, reason, metric, direction, baseline_kind, baseline_reference, baseline_value, current_value, absolute_degradation, relative_degradation, tolerance, tolerance_mode, threshold_value, labeled_rows, label_coverage, consecutive_failures, required_windows, action, action_reason, request_id, run_id, metric AS metric_name FROM performance_history

datasets.name: performance_policy_series
datasets.displayName: Performance policy current baseline and boundary
queryLines:
WITH selected AS (
 SELECT * FROM performance_history WHERE metric = :policy_metric AND model_name = :policy_model AND model_version = :policy_version
), identity_count AS (SELECT count(DISTINCT monitor_id) AS monitors FROM selected)
SELECT report_id, monitor_id, model_catalog, model_schema, model_name, model_version, measured_at, metric AS metric_name, current_value AS value, 'Current' AS series FROM selected WHERE (SELECT monitors FROM identity_count) = 1
UNION ALL
SELECT report_id, monitor_id, model_catalog, model_schema, model_name, model_version, measured_at, metric AS metric_name, baseline_value AS value, 'Baseline' AS series FROM selected WHERE (SELECT monitors FROM identity_count) = 1
UNION ALL
SELECT report_id, monitor_id, model_catalog, model_schema, model_name, model_version, measured_at, metric AS metric_name, threshold_value AS value, 'Tolerance boundary' AS series FROM selected WHERE (SELECT monitors FROM identity_count) = 1
ORDER BY measured_at, report_id, series
